INSERT INTO fact_sales
  (company_id, date_key, customer_key, item_key, frappe_doctype, frappe_doc_name, frappe_doc_item_row,
   quantity, uom, unit_price, discount_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, cost_amount, margin_amount, currency)
VALUES
  ({{$json.company_id}}, {{$json.date_key}}, {{$json.customer_key}}, {{$json.item_key}}, 'Sales Invoice',
   '{{$json.frappe_doc_name}}', '{{$json.frappe_doc_item_row}}',
   {{$json.quantity}}, '{{$json.uom}}', {{$json.unit_price}}, {{$json.discount_amount}},
   {{$json.tax_amount}}, {{$json.total_amount}}, {{$json.cost_amount}},
   {{$json.total_amount - $json.cost_amount}}, '{{$json.currency}}')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  quantity = VALUES(quantity), unit_price = VALUES(unit_price),
  discount_amount = VALUES(discount_amount), tax_amount = VALUES(tax_amount),
  total_amount = VALUES(total_amount), cost_amount = VALUES(cost_amount),
  margin_amount = VALUES(margin_amount), synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

INSERT INTO etl_sync_state (company_id, frappe_doctype, last_synced_modified, last_run_started_at, last_run_finished_at, status, records_last_run)
VALUES ({{$json.company_id}}, '{{$json.frappe_doctype}}', '{{$json.max_modified}}', NOW(), NOW(), 'idle', 0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  last_synced_modified = VALUES(last_synced_modified),
  last_run_finished_at = NOW(),
  status = 'idle';
